jobs.label: Плато
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent landscape ground layer for a graphic-design key visual, onto which separate design elements will later be placed.
Input image 1: the user's new crystal landscape is a MATERIAL, GEOMETRY LANGUAGE, COLOR and RENDERING STYLE reference. Use its milky translucent lavender/ice-blue crystal with soft pearly peach highlights, broad angular glassy planes, subtle internal cloudy refractive variations, slightly irregular reflective surfaces and sharp fractured edges. The terrain is a connected crystalline mass of faceted ramps and slabs, not a scattering of ordinary quartz needle specimens. Design a NEW distribution of shapes and masses, independent of the reference's exact arrangement.
Framing: wide landscape composition, 3:2 canvas. The ground occupies the lower roughly 60% of the image; the highest few formations can reach 30–35% down from the top. Leave generous empty alpha above the silhouette. The surface extends beyond both side edges and is cut by the bottom edge; fill the full bottom edge with terrain. No visible floating-island base, no lower outline or underside. Camera close to the ground from a low oblique three-quarter viewpoint, enough top surface visible to place design elements later. Include broad usable faceted landing areas.
Material and shape: large, varied, irregular polygonal facets; incisive diagonal edges and an angular serrated skyline appropriate to the reference. Match the reference's translucent, opalescent icy lavender crystal, restrained cool reflections and warm peach gleams, nuanced subtle texture within the faces. Broad planar ramps meet shallow glassy concavities and fractured crests. High-quality clean tactile CGI, soft coherent directional light with clear depth. Maintain delicate light transmission without washing out the facets.
Background: true transparent PNG alpha everywhere above the irregular landscape silhouette. Do NOT copy the reference's blue background. No colored sky, external haze or glow, background plane, checkerboard backdrop, text, logo or watermark. No vegetation, products, decorative props or added objects. No smooth fur-like dunes, rounded inflated shapes, solid white snow, ordinary rock or chrome metal.

This variation's unique composition:
A low broad crystalline plateau dominates the foreground and central-right region, formed from three or four spacious irregular faceted planes. A compact asymmetric crag occupies the rear LEFT third, with several low jagged broken ridges tapering toward the right. Compose a largely open level landing surface with a diagonal fracture seam. The upper profile slopes down from left to right, rather than forming two matching hills with a central dip. No dense spires.
